report.root_cause: AuditTrail config (plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml) was changed to debug: true at ~06:29:45, causing the plugin to write very large trace logs to plugins/AuditTrail/debug/ (~1.5 MB/s, 80 MB in under a minute).
report.actions: Observed disk growing 23MB to 71MB; found debug trace logs via fs_du; declared incident; set debug: false in AuditTrail config and reloaded the plugin (console 'audittrail reload'); deleted the debug trace directory; verified disk back at 23 MB and stable, TPS 20, with no server restart.
report.residual_risk: I don't know who or what turned debug on. If it happens again, the disk will fill again. Nothing alerts on disk growth or on the AuditTrail config. The early MSPT spikes at startup were not investigated further.
